basic_info.description: Spacious and updated full-floor 3BD/2BA penthouse condo in a charming 6-unit building in Lower Pacific Heights. Nestled on a tree-lined street among classic San Francisco homes, this top-floor residence is filled with natural light, vaulted ceilings, and architectural details including exposed brick and skylights. The chef's kitchen is fully equipped with a Viking range, Sub-Zero fridge, Bosch dishwasher, wine fridge, green soapstone counters, and custom cabinetry. Additional features include in-unit laundry, hardwood floors, recessed lighting, dual-paned windows, custom closets, fresh paint, and custom roman shades throughout. The layout offers great separation between bedrooms and entertaining spaces, plus a den and formal dining area. Enjoy outdoor living with a private-use deck with gas BBQ hookup and access to a shared yard. Conveniently located near Alta Plaza Park, Fillmore & Divisadero corridors, California & Geary Streets, and close to Laurel Heights and the Presidio.
